info.name: ASSET002 - Human-in-the-Loop Support Triage
info.description: Exercises the published ASSET002 Chatwoot webhook with synthetic message_created events. Run requests in order. HTTP 200 confirms that n8n accepted the event; inspect n8n executions, Chatwoot private notes, and the asset002_audit tables to verify asynchronous outcomes.

exec: pm.test('n8n accepted the webhook event', function () {

item.name: 01 - Standard Incoming Customer Message
item.description: Creates unique synthetic identifiers for this run. Expected result: a new audit claim, AI triage, grounded response preparation when knowledge matches, and a private Chatwoot review note.

body.raw:
{
  "event": "message_created",
  "id": "{{standardMessageId}}",
  "message_type": "incoming",
  "private": false,
  "content": "Where can I download a copy of my latest invoice?",
  "created_at": "2026-07-31T12:00:00.000Z",
  "account": { "id": "{{accountId}}" },
  "inbox": { "id": "{{inboxId}}" },
  "conversation": { "id": "{{conversationId}}", "inbox_id": "{{inboxId}}", "channel": "Channel::WebWidget" },
  "sender": { "name": "Postman Customer", "email": "postman.customer@example.com" }
}

item.name: 02 - Exact Duplicate Replay
item.description: Replays request 01 with the same business identifiers. Expected result: Duplicate Event Ignored; no second AI call or Chatwoot draft.

body.raw:
{
  "event": "message_created",
  "id": "{{standardMessageId}}",
  "message_type": "incoming",
  "private": false,
  "content": "Where can I download a copy of my latest invoice?",
  "created_at": "2026-07-31T12:00:00.000Z",
  "account": { "id": "{{accountId}}" },
  "inbox": { "id": "{{inboxId}}" },
  "conversation": { "id": "{{conversationId}}", "inbox_id": "{{inboxId}}", "channel": "Channel::WebWidget" },
  "sender": { "name": "Postman Customer", "email": "postman.customer@example.com" }
}

item.name: 03 - Sensitive Security Request
item.description: Expected result: priority_review with security/sensitivity reason codes, no AI response draft, and manual handling in the private note.

body.raw:
{
  "event": "message_created",
  "id": "{{sensitiveMessageId}}",
  "message_type": "incoming",
  "private": false,
  "content": "My account may be compromised and I can see another customer's personal information. Please disable access immediately.",
  "created_at": "2026-07-31T12:01:00.000Z",
  "account": { "id": "{{accountId}}" },
  "inbox": { "id": "{{inboxId}}" },
  "conversation": { "id": "{{conversationId}}", "inbox_id": "{{inboxId}}", "channel": "Channel::WebWidget" },
  "sender": { "name": "Postman Security Test", "email": "security.test@example.com" }
}

item.name: 04 - Invalid Incoming Event
item.description: Omits account ID and message content. Expected result: Invalid Event Rejected before idempotency, Chatwoot history, or AI calls. Validation errors must not echo submitted data.

item.name: 05 - Public Agent Response Delivery
item.description: Simulates a public outgoing Chatwoot message. Expected result: an agent_deliveries audit row containing the final response; no AI processing.

body.raw:
{
  "event": "message_created",
  "id": "{{agentMessageId}}",
  "message_type": "outgoing",
  "private": false,
  "content": "You can download the approved invoice from the Billing section of your account.",
  "created_at": "2026-07-31T12:05:00.000Z",
  "account": { "id": "{{accountId}}" },
  "inbox": { "id": "{{inboxId}}" },
  "conversation": { "id": "{{conversationId}}", "inbox_id": "{{inboxId}}", "channel": "Channel::WebWidget" },
  "sender": { "name": "Postman Support Agent", "email": "agent@example.com" }
}

item.name: 06 - Private Chatwoot Note Ignored
item.description: Simulates the private note created by the workflow. Expected result: Ignored Chatwoot Event, preventing a webhook loop.

body.raw:
{
  "event": "message_created",
  "id": "{{privateNoteId}}",
  "message_type": "outgoing",
  "private": true,
  "content": "AI support triage — internal review only",
  "created_at": "2026-07-31T12:06:00.000Z",
  "account": { "id": "{{accountId}}" },
  "inbox": { "id": "{{inboxId}}" },
  "conversation": { "id": "{{conversationId}}", "inbox_id": "{{inboxId}}", "channel": "Channel::WebWidget" },
  "sender": { "name": "Automation" }
}
